inputs.text: The important point is that Israelis, who live with the danger, strongly support seeing the war through despite the costs. People abroad can focus on energy prices and canceled flights, but a nation’s first duty is the security of its people—not winning approval from distant critics. Resolve and continuity matter when a country’s safety is at stake.
